scope: Independent review of eight named native captures and targeted AppKit source. Incumbent-world extension; no new quality-bar card, comp or concept seed. No web detector ran. Physical keyboard, VoiceOver, IME and release acceptance remain outside the review.
persistence: Pass. PRODUCT.md records the approved hierarchy. Existing DESIGN.md matches the native world; new component documentation remains assigned to the documenter.

fidelity.finding: Match: system typography, readable hierarchy, monospace for code.
Match: native controls, tables, panels, chrome and symbols.
Match: semantic dark and light surfaces.
Match: conversation and composer remain dominant; context stays secondary at both captured sizes.
Match: explicit conversation identity, restored draft and cleared inspection state.
Match: scoped filename/path search, deliberate activation, empty state, Return/Escape/arrow handling.
Contradicted at initial review: Cmd-L leaves the modeless picker as the key window.

ceiling: No additional visual devices warranted within the established AppKit world. All required captures are valid.

material_fixes.requirement: In WorkspaceWindow.focusComposer(), dismiss QuickOpen, make the workspace window key, then focus the composer. App.swift correctly routes Cmd-L through the picker's parent, but changing only that parent's first responder leaves keyboard input in the picker.

keep: Preserve the conversation-first hierarchy, semantic AppKit treatment, explicit search scope, deliberate file activation and per-conversation draft isolation.

verdict.scope: The scored composer-focus fix and attributable regressions only.
verdict.evidence: composer-focused-wide.png shows the picker dismissed and draft retained. Diagnostics recorded before capture confirm workspaceKey=true and composerFocused=true; targeted source implements the required focus handoff.
verdict.captures: All nine captures are valid. No attributable regressions observed.
verdict.remaining: Clear for the scored fix. Physical keyboard, IME and VoiceOver acceptance remain unverified.
